library.location: i-appydave presenter library (git: appydave-image-projects/i-appydave) + Headshot Picker artefact for browsing/labels
library.private: Shared 'anyone with the link' (view only). A plain script fetch gets Cloudflare's bot check (HTTP 403, 2026-09-27); whether ChatGPT's browsing can read it is untested. Image generation needs the PNGs attached regardless, so attach them from cutout.path.

thinking.note: Thinking gesture is not present in the original

fallback_policy.missing_gesture: Use an approved portrait and composite without changing the gesture, or generate a proposed variation for identity review
fallback_policy.missing_expression: Select the closest available natural expression
fallback_policy.missing_file: Report missing asset; do not substitute another person

usage_rule.meaning: Library photos teach the model WHO David is (face, glasses, hair, age, build, shirt). The model then CREATES the pose, expression, gaze and lighting the story needs. Do not pick a photo because its expression matches and paste it.
pick_references_by: lighting close to the target scene
literal_use_only_when: the video is about the photos themselves (e.g. d06 candidate cards)
an exact existing pose is explicitly wanted
usage_rule.why: David 2026-09-27: the board was made from 3 neutral/standing shots + 1 expression and invented 8 brilliant expressions; test 1 copied cutouts and looked like Canva. Test 2 (reference mode) invented a pointing pose that exists nowhere in the library and reached board quality.

reference_pool.source: Headshot Picker db collection 'labels' (David's labels; 'favourites' is now just one label). Prefer label 'neutrals-mujfs8ui' (David's 'Neutrals': baseline images, expression added by the model); while it is empty, use 'neutral-no-expression' then 'favourites'.
reference_pool.pick_by: outfit + angle for the scene, NEVER expression
reference_pool.david_does: curate favourites once; never picks per thumbnail
reference_pool.changed: 2026-10-03: picker moved from prefs.fav stars to named labels (portraits-rsch v7)
